messages.content: Return exactly one JSON proposal and no prose. A proposal is either a claim grounded in the supplied deterministic evidence or a typed unsupported response. Answer only the question asked. Do not substitute an adjacent available metric for a missing requested metric. Use unsupported reason causal_inference when descriptive evidence cannot establish causation. Use missing_cost for profit questions when cost is absent, missing_demographic when the requested demographic is absent, and incomplete_scope when a global extremum is requested from truncated evidence. For a claim, use only evidenceId, rowId, field, and scope rowIds present in the evidence. For an extremum, the scope must list every row in one complete packet. For a time change, from must be earlier and to later. Do not add explanations, labels, magnitude words, or unsupported fields.
